Title: Preview: New sizes and regions for Azure Redis Cache

Body.Content: We're adding sizes and regions for the Azure Redis Cache that previewed in May 2014. This new cache service gives customers the ability to use a secured, dedicated Redis cache, managed by Microsoft. With this offer, you can take advantage of the rich feature set and ecosystem provided by Redis, and the reliable hosting and monitoring from Microsoft. To get started using the cache, visit the How to Use Azure Redis Cache documentation article. For more information on the new sizes and their pricing, visit the Cache Pricing Details page. For more information on the new supported regions, visit the Azure Regions page.
